source.title: Statistics Bureau of Japan · 2025 Census, final population results, table 1-1
source.note: Population counts refer to usual residents on census day. Current municipal rows only; city wards are parts of their designated city, not additional population. Reference area is reported in km². Census does not cover the six claimed villages administered by Russia.

checks: All 47 prefecture populations equal the sum of their municipalities.
All 20 designated-city populations equal the sum of their city wards.
No old 2000 municipal row is used.
